def: to cram, i.e. glut or sate

occurrences.text: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.
Now ye are full, now ye are rich, ye have reigned as kings without us: and I would to God ye did reign, that we also might reign with you.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
